experiment_label: accelerated D1 synthetic stepped pod-demand-proxy replay on a benchmark Kubernetes service
selection_rule: Parse every D1 stepped test filename. A scenario is timing-eligible when one nominal source plateau (step_duration hours × four 15-minute observations/hour × 10 replay seconds/observation) lasts at least 330 seconds, covering the unchanged 300-second tuned-HPA stabilization plus two nominal HPA cycles. Infer the recurring boundary phase that maximizes median absolute adjacent change. Using core medians after a one-quarter-plateau transition guard, require two adjacent opposite-direction changes each at least 20% of the configured min-max amplitude. Choose shortest nominal duration, then lowest scenario ID, then earliest eligible triplet. This controller-independent rule selects scenario 62 and was frozen before any controller run.

transformation.time: Each observed 900-second source interval becomes one constant 10-second replay bin (90x acceleration).
transformation.mapping_interpretation: controller-independent experimental demand proxy, not observed HTTP traffic
transformation.interpolation: none; observed values are held constant within each replay bin
transformation.difference_from_growing_onoff: Same affine 20-120 RPS envelope; stepped uses its frozen selected-window extrema and a longer predeclared measurement to preserve full plateaus.

time_scale_assessment.interpretation: Individual noisy 10-second bins are below HPA metric resolution, but each 400-second main plateau spans about 26.7 metric/HPA resolutions, 40 PHPA sync periods, and exceeds tuned-HPA scale-down stabilization by 100 seconds.

transition_analysis.response_baseline: last telemetry sample strictly before boundary
transition_analysis.response: first matching desired/ready replica change from the baseline
transition_analysis.pre_step_capacity_sufficient: zero failures in the first 30 seconds after an upward step
transition_analysis.down_excess_capacity: integral of max(ready - final-60-second minimum ready, 0) over the lower plateau
transition_analysis.lag_resolution_warning: lags closer than the 5-second collector cadence are not distinguishable
transition_analysis.proactivity_rule: only a desired increase before the observed upward boundary counts as temporal pre-scaling; surplus replicas alone do not
